pages.title: Caffeine Dream
pages.text: Caffeine Dream plays in Detroit, the ninth race in Skitchin', which runs 6.4 miles. The password is CARS, for the Motor City.

pages.title: The drivers to watch for
pages.text: The game's TV host warns you about each city's traffic, which can mean drunk drivers, granny drivers, cabbies, lead foots or paranoid drivers. Some of them pop the trunk to knock you off, and grannies hit the brakes when they see you.
